# $crav1-fix-build-gaps

lane: build | group: Verify and fix | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.0.0 | prompts: 3
purpose: Fix gaps a build left, one at a time inside the spec; asks verify-report gaps or live-site gaps.
use_when: verify.md lists gaps, or a live host path fails
reads: Verify report gaps: Reads `verify.md` and the spec folder. Live-site gaps: Reads the same queue as `$crav1-fix-build-gaps`.
writes: Verify report gaps: Writes the smallest in-spec fix, an appended `fix-log.md`, and that one `verify.md` row when the file exists. Live-site gaps: Writes what that skill writes.
leaves alone: Verify report gaps: Leaves `spec.md` and unimplemented tasks alone. Live-site gaps: Leaves `spec.md` alone.
limits: Verify report gaps: does not run `$crav1-fix-bug`. Live-site gaps: prefers live or untested wiring rows. When the fix changes how the parts connect, it asks once whether to run `$crav1-refresh-system-notes` and does not run it.
flow:
- the reply is one lead sentence and the shared ending, never a `Next:` line: a Catch up first block with `$crav1-finalize-commit` and, when the fix is on an unpushed pull request branch, `$crav1-open-pr pr<n>`, then the next gap or `$crav1-verify-build-against-spec <slug>`.
- before the first code edit on a base branch, offers Create `fix/<slug>` from the into branch (Recommended), an existing branch, another name or stop; never edits code there; headless stops unless `new-branch`.
- a typed branch name is that card's free-text answer, hint `Type a branch name`.
- **`$crav1-fix-build-gaps`** opens with one question: gaps from the verify report, or a live-site gap (ports, proxy, SQL, unpublished URL).
- Verify report gaps (was `$crav1-fix-from-verify`): After verify-build-against-spec, walk inner-loop gaps (failed → unverified → `G#`); omit Gap for the next; writes `fix-log.md`.
- Live-site gaps (was `$crav1-fix-live`): Alias when that gap is a live/inner-loop path.

## Choice words
- question: Which gaps
  - `verify-gaps`: gaps from the verify report
  - `live-gaps`: live-site gaps
- question: Branch
  - `new-branch`: on a base or other branch, create fix/<slug> from the into branch
called_by: Called by the user and by `crav1-build-task-agent`.
runs by itself: Verify report gaps: Calls no skill. Live-site gaps: Calls `$crav1-fix-build-gaps`.
you run next: $crav1-verify-build-against-spec
first: `$crav1-fix-build-gaps @docs/specs/<slug>/verify.md`
walkthrough: from-verify.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.203.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-fix-build-gaps.md
